trust_decision.summary: METADATA MISMATCH: the candidate record describes sniffer-filter command injection (CWE-78), but all three fix commits are 'SAML audience confusion allows cross-SP authentication'. The diff decides whether a signed SAML assertion was issued for this NeuVector SP: SAMLSPAuth accepts any assertion whose audience matches the client-supplied redirect_endpoint, and it ignores the library's NotInAudience/OneTimeUse warnings.

landing_point.why: For the SAML diff: the only post-validation check in SAMLSPAuth looks at InvalidTime and nothing else. (An engineer who read only the record's sniffer summary would land on agent/sniffer.go:503-515, which already passes the filter after '--' at the pinned commit.)

fix_sites.module_kind: shared auth library (share/auth): enforcement of the audience/OneTimeUse warnings

fix_sites.entry_point: GenerateSamlSP, a public func reached from SAMLSPAuth, SAMLSPGetRedirectURL and SAMLSPGetLogoutURL
fix_sites.module_kind: shared auth library: SP builder (AudienceURI producer)

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /v1/server, PATCH /v1/server/{name} (controller/rest/server.go:1102, controller/rest/server.go:1223), configmap saml loader (controller/rest/configmap.go:147)
REST request schema RESTServerSAMLConfig (also embedded in RESTServerSAMLConfigCfgMap, controller/api/apis.go:462-465)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: share/clus_apis.go:1003 (persisted CLUSServerSAML) plus controller/rest/server.go:841-846 / controller/rest/server.go:114-118; the configmap loader controller/rest/configmap.go:115-147 picks the field up through the embedded struct without being edited

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report concerns login validation in share/auth. A configurable audience means a new feature across the API schema, the KV schema and the configmap. A solver can argue that rejecting NotInAudience is enough, even though the expected audience is still the request's own redirect_endpoint.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Existing SAML servers with no audience configured must keep logging in. The published fix only warns on NotInAudience when AudienceURI is empty. A fix that always rejects, or that pins the audience or Recipient to a value the IdP does not send, breaks current deployments and the existing auth tests.

O6_input_shapes: assertion whose Audience differs from the SP audience (NotInAudience)
AudienceURI arriving via REST create/patch vs the configmap loader (same struct)

O7_producer.where: controller/rest/server.go:796 updateSAMLServer (called from controller/rest/server.go:1102, controller/rest/server.go:1223, controller/rest/configmap.go:147) writes CLUSServerSAML; SAMLSPAuth reads it back from KV via controller/rest/auth.go:2774

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Response Destination and SubjectConfirmationData Recipient are compared against AssertionConsumerServiceURL, which the fix still sets from the client-supplied redirect_endpoint, so the 'intended for this SP' binding remains request-controlled
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names audience only. The ACS URL has to equal the redirect for the IdP round-trip, and redirect-as-SP-identity is labelled backward compatibility (share/auth/auth.go:225)
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function as the fix; compared inside vendor/github.com/russellhaering/gosaml2/decode_response.go:48 and vendor/github.com/russellhaering/gosaml2/validate.go:215

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A SAML LogoutResponse/IdP-initiated SLO validator that builds its SP via GenerateSamlSP and checks only signature and time
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: SLO is already supported (SLOEnabled/SLOURL), and a maintainer adding response handling would copy the SAMLSPAuth pattern

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A configmap/import path that rebuilds CLUSServerSAML field by field and drops AudienceURI on reload
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Federation/import paths often copy fields explicitly. Losing the field silently re-enables the warn-only fallback

O9_family: authentication: SAML assertion audience/recipient binding (CWE-287/CWE-345); the record's stated CWE-78 does not match the diff

O10_build.project_tests: share/auth/auth_test.go (SAMLSPAuth with fake clock and test IdP responses, line 211); controller/rest/auth_test.go mocks SAMLSPAuth (line 64)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Return an error when WarningInfo.NotInAudience is set at share/auth/auth.go:311. This leaves AudienceURI equal to the attacker-chosen redirect_endpoint (share/auth/auth.go:212), so the check still passes.

out_of_scope_notes: Sniffer filter: agent/sniffer.go:509-513 already passes the BPF filter as one argument after '--' at the pinned commit; the history includes e06d787b 'fix: prevent command injection in sniffer filter'.
OIDC path verifies ClientID audience (share/auth/auth.go:435); not pursued.
